thread:
Ben - Recruiting Ops: Heads-up — after last night's ATS upgrade some historical scorecards are showing shifted rating labels. Appears 5->4 mapping happened, so a bunch of '5 - Strong hire' became 4 or 0. Can anyone confirm? :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Maya - People Ops: yikes. Which projects / time range?
Ben - Recruiting Ops: all interviews submitted between 2024-11-01 and 2024-11-05 (we rolled the new rubric then). Sample candidate IDs: 1137, 1142. UI shows weird labels.
Devon - Recruiter: saw it on #eng-hiring too — some scorecards show '0' in the score field but human label says Strong hire. Prob mapping mismatch when we switched scale.
Anika - Eng Mgr: We ran interviewer training on the new rubric last Tues, but I told folks we'd rely on old baseline for candidates already in pipeline. Looks like that's not what the ATS did.
Ben - Recruiting Ops: I pulled DB rows, rating_value column changed. Old values 1-5, new enum 0-4, they ran an automatic rebase. Not great.
Sam - Data Eng: If we need a quick backfill we can run a one-off SQL map: 
```
UPDATE scorecards
SET rating_value = CASE rating_value
  WHEN 0 THEN 1
  WHEN 1 THEN 2
  WHEN 2 THEN 3
  WHEN 3 THEN 4
  WHEN 4 THEN 5
END
WHERE created_at < '2024-11-06' AND source = 'old_rubric_migration_job';
```
But need approvals (audit log) and downtime window.
Maya - People Ops: We need to preserve audit trail. Can we instead add a display-layer mapping so historical views show original labels and avoid DB writes?
Sam - Data Eng: Yes, easier and safer. We can add computed field in API to map old enum back. Low risk and reversible.
Devon - Recruiter: That would fix what hiring managers see immediately without touching DB. :thumbsup: 
Anika - Eng Mgr: Approved to do display mapping for now. Please also flag affected candidates so we can re-run calibration on final slate.
Ben - Recruiting Ops: Action items: Sam will add display-layer mapping today; I'll compile affected candidate list and notify hiring teams; Maya will open change request for audit and long-term DB migration if needed.
Sam - Data Eng: I'll have a PR by EOD and post link here.
ATS-bot: Deploy started for feature/scorecard-legacy-views — build 1872
Ben - Recruiting Ops: thanks everyone. I'll post the candidate list in the doc and ping ops for audit sign-off. :pray:
